title: Clicking a desktop only moves the primary display's desktop when desktops are configured to switch independently per screen
line: With desktops switching independently per screen, clicking a desktop in the Pager now switches every screen to it, not only the screen the Pager is on.
explanation: With per-screen virtual desktops, each Pager cell shows a desktop across all screens, but clicking it asked KWin to switch only the Pager's own screen. The other screens stayed on their old desktop while the Pager highlighted the whole cell. Now, when the Pager shows all screens, a click (or wheel step) switches every screen to that desktop; with 'Show only the current screen' it still switches just its own screen.

commits.message:
applets/pager: switch all screens when the pager shows all screens

With per-screen virtual desktops, clicking a desktop only switched the
screen the pager is on, although each cell shows every screen. When the
pager shows all screens, switch every screen to the clicked desktop.

BUG: 522014

media.caption: Master, two screens, per-screen desktops: after clicking desktop 2 in the Pager (zoomed below), only the left screen switched; Dolphin is still on the right screen's desktop 1
With the fix, same click: both screens switch to desktop 2 (Konsole and Dolphin both gone)

review.text: Switching all screens when a Pager shows all screens (!showOnlyCurrentScreen) while preserving single-screen switching for showOnlyCurrentScreen is a clean UX choice matching the bug discussion. However, PagerModel::changePage() still short-circuits on currentPage() == page, where currentPage() only checks the Pager's own screen (d->screenName). When screens are on different desktops in per-output mode and the user clicks the desktop that is already current on the Pager's screen, the other screens fail to switch (and showDesktop even toggles the dashboard instead), contradicting the commit message and summary.
changes: In PagerModel::changePage(int page), when d->pagerType == VirtualDesktops && !d->screenName.isEmpty() && !d->showOnlyCurrentScreen, check whether all screens in qGuiApp->screens() are already on desktopId (via currentDesktopByScreenName() with a bounds check on page) before treating the page as already active / invoking toggleDashboard; otherwise activate desktopId on the screens not already on it.
Verify the diverged-screens case (e.g. Screen 1 on Desktop 1, Screen 2 on Desktop 2, clicking Desktop 1 in the all-screens Pager switches Screen 2 to Desktop 1).

reviews.text: Switching every output when the Pager shows all screens matches what the reporter and c3 expect (the click target is the whole highlighted cell), the change is in the right place, keeps 'Show only the current screen' per-output, and the before/after screenshots plus KWin currentDesktopForScreen readings prove it. But the notes admit a hole that per-screen mode makes common: if the Pager's own screen is already on the clicked desktop and another screen is not (e.g. left on 1, right on 2, click desktop 1), changePage() takes the currentPage() == page branch and nothing switches, so clicking a cell still doesn't bring all its screens there. That leaves the reported behaviour in place for part of the cases, so it doesn't fully close the bug.
changes: In changePage(), when the Pager shows all screens, treat the page as current only if every screen is on that desktop (check currentDesktopByScreenName for each qGuiApp screen); otherwise run the all-screens switch, and keep the show-desktop toggle for the truly-current case
Verify on the rig: screens on different desktops, click the Pager screen's current desktop, both screens end on it
Optional: when per-output desktops are off, keep a single requestActivate/requestActivateOnScreen call instead of one request per screen
